entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dude, I could totally get used to all[n]this flyin' through space shit! But we're[n]almost at the end...
entries.uk: Чувак, я б до цих польотів у космосі[n]запросто звик! Але ми вже майже[n]в кінці...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You don't look so good, Oracle.[n]Is everything okay?
entries.uk: Щось ти недобре виглядаєш, Оракуле.[n]Усе гаразд?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: She must have gotten motion sickness...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's not much further to the Treasure.[n]Hang in there, Oracle!
